# Nerd Utility API — llms.txt

Free, no-auth utility endpoints on :8080. GET-friendly (params in query string) or POST JSON.

## Endpoints
- /.well-known/agent-card.json
- /.well-known/ai-plugin.json
- /agent-card.json
- /ai-plugin.json
- /alerts
- /case
- /cert

- /hook/
- /hook/new
- /ipinfo
- /json2csv
- /jwt-decode
- /llms.txt
- /lorem

- /md

- /openapi.json
- /password
- /price

- /robots.txt

- /ua-parse

- /validate
- /weather
- /whois

Webhook tester: GET /hook returns a unique capture URL; send any request there; GET /hook/<id> to inspect.

Full spec: /openapi.json — Docs: /docs
## /pipeline
Chain up to 20 utility ops in one POST: {"input":"hello","steps":[{"op":"upper"},{"op":"hash","options":{"algo":"md5"}}]}. Ops: base64, hash, upper, lower, trim, json_parse, url, hex. GET returns docs.
## /slug
URL slug generation with diacritic stripping and separator control. POST {"text":"Héllo World"} or GET /slug?text=...
## /roman
Roman numeral conversion. ?q=2026 -> MMXXVI, ?q=MCMXCIV -> 1994. Integers 1-3999 both directions.
## /nato
NATO phonetic alphabet. ?q=text -> "Alfa Bravo..."; mode=decode reverses. Unknown chars skipped.
## /isbn
ISBN validation/conversion. ?q=isbn validates ISBN-10/13 checksums; ?mode=convert converts between formats.
## /luhn
Luhn algorithm. ?q=4532015112830366 (validate with brand hint), ?q=453201511283036&mode=checkdigit (compute missing digit). Spaces/dashes tolerated.
## /useragent
Parse a User-Agent. ?ua=<string> -> browser, engine, OS, device type, bot detection.
## /iban
IBAN validation. ?q=GB82WEST12345698765432 -> valid, country, formatted, check digits.
## /eth
Ethereum address validation. ?q=0x... -> format check, EIP-55 checksum verification. ?mode=checksum returns checksummed form.
## /eth
Ethereum address validation. ?q=0x... -> format check, EIP-55 checksum validation; ?mode=checksum returns the checksummed form.
## /base58
Base58 encode/decode (?encode=/?decode=/?text=) and Bitcoin address validation (?btc=) with base58check + bech32 checksums, address type detection.
## /jwt
JWT decode (?jwt=): header/payload/alg, HS256/384/512 signature verify with ?secret=, exp/nbf/iat checks.
## /domain
DNS records lookup (?domain=example.com, ?type=A|AAAA|MX|TXT|NS|CNAME|SOA|SRV, default all).
## /password
Password generation (?length=24&count=2, class toggles lower/upper/digits/symbols/ambiguous) + strength analysis (?analyze=pw): entropy bits, strength, warnings.
## /cron
Cron expression parser (?expr=): field breakdown, plain-English explanation, next N runs in UTC (?count=).
## /semver
Semver parse (?v=1.2.3) and compare (?a=&b=): prerelease ordering per spec. Note: URL-encode + in build metadata as %2B.
